_about: Frame lists for the scene-synchronization GIFs in images/generated/scene-sync/.
Every frame named here is a TRACKED capture from a physical D435 -> Isaac run;
the assembler never records anything itself and refuses a frame it cannot find,
so re-running the generator cannot replace this evidence with a generated-scenario
capture. `hold` is how many GIF frames the still is shown for at `fps`.

physical-to-isaac-pick.gif.source: run 3: LIVE D435 acquisition on 2026-09-12 of placement 1 (same physical placement as 2026-09-11), synchronized into Isaac through the configured demo transform and picked by the existing Panda backend; DemoCamera frames captured with WISEPACK_ISAAC_CAPTURE_DIR
physical-to-isaac-pick.gif.footer: LIVE physical D435 -> FoundationPose (model-free) -> CONFIGURED DEMO camera-to-workarea transform -> Isaac Sim, Panda. No calibrated accuracy claimed.
